content:
Custom Inventory Location

Define custom inventory locations for tracking stock in different warehouses or areas.

Each location can track inventory quantities and movements separately.

Name

Enter a descriptive name for this inventory location (e.g., 'Main Warehouse', 'Store #1', 'Eastern Distribution Center').

Code

Optionally assign a unique code to this location for quick reference in reports and transactions.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this location. Inactive locations will not appear in selection lists but historical data will be preserved.
